title: Search While Indexing
subheading: How to search all files while indexing

contents.Text: [[[strong:Settings -> Config -> Use Legacy Search:]]] Set this setting to [[[strong:on]]] while you are indexing a directory.
This allows you to search all files using the old search implementation, which works by scanning the entire directory and returning results.

[[[warning:Note:]]] Make sure to turn [[[strong:Use Legacy Search]]] [[[strong:off]]] after indexing if you want a more efficient search with new features like [[[strong:(length:>=2m)]]] and others. See the [[[button:Search][/Main Window/Search]]] page for more information.
